description: This source file defines the `WorkingDaysUtil` utility class, which provides static methods for handling working day calculations, including determining if a date is a working day, adjusting dates if they fall on a non-working day, and retrieving the rescheduling type for repayments.

classes.name: WorkingDaysUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for managing working days, adjusting dates, and retrieving repayment rescheduling types.

methods.name: getOffSetDateIfNonWorkingDay
methods.description: Recursively adjusts a given date to the next or previous working day based on the rescheduling type if the date falls on a non-working day.

methods.name: isWorkingDay
methods.description: Checks if a specific date is a working day based on the working days configuration.

methods.name: isNonWorkingDay
methods.description: Checks if a specific date is a non-working day by negating the result of `isWorkingDay`.

methods.name: updateWorkingDayIfRepaymentDateIsNonWorkingDay
methods.description: Updates the repayment date in the adjusted date DTO if it falls on a non-working day, adjusting it accordingly.

methods.name: getRepaymentRescheduleType
methods.description: Retrieves the rescheduling type (as an enum) from the WorkingDays configuration.
